name: arrayFilter
description: This function creates a new Array that returns all the values from an array that match the given filter.
syntax: arrayFilter( array array, function filter, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: filter
params.description:
A function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(any arg){ return true/false;}`

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
